title: Pactias
summary: Raleigh names Pactias in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Pactias, whom a gapped name imployed against the Nations that reuolted after Cyrus left Asia the lesse, before Harpagus. The gap was not filled. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
